title: Fireblocks Denies Report of $2.5 Billion Visa Takeover Talks
summary:
Bitcoin Magazine

Fireblocks Denies Report of $2.5 Billion Visa Takeover Talks

Fireblocks has denied an Axios report that Visa is in late-stage talks to acquire the crypto custody firm for about $2.5 billion.

This post Fireblocks Denies Report of $2.5 Billion Visa Takeover Talks first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman.

title: Central Bank of Ireland Fines Coinbase Unit €3.25 Million Over Customer Fund Safeguarding Failures
summary:
Bitcoin Magazine

Central Bank of Ireland Fines Coinbase Unit €3.25 Million Over Customer Fund Safeguarding Failures

Ireland’s central bank has fined Coinbase Ireland €3.25 million for allowing customer funds to mix with other Coinbase entities’ money and for relying on its US parent to run safeguarding controls.

This post Central Bank of Ireland Fines Coinbase Unit €3.25 Million Over Customer Fund Safeguarding Failures first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman.
